1. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE — WHAT THE SYSTEM IS
-------------------------------------------
Vistamations is NOT a project, NOT a folder, NOT a workspace. It is a SYSTEM.

    Vistamations System (C:\vistamations-music)
    │
    ├── LOCAL SUB-SYSTEM
    │   └── Local Environment (Docker + Windows)
    │       ├── Docker stack: nginx (80), app:3000, Redis (6379), Prometheus (9090)
    │       ├── OpenClaw Gateway (port 18789)
    │       ├── 6 scheduled Windows tasks
    │       ├── 17 API routes (Express in server.js)
    │       ├── All static web pages & applications
    │       └── Pete's files: .vscode/pete/ (4-value ID structure)
    │
    └── CLOUD SUB-SYSTEM
        ├── Cloudflare Environment
        │   ├── D1 database: vistamations-agent-memory (AGENT_DB)
        │   ├── Workers: vistamations-agent-memory, mya, vistamations-home-bento
        │   └── KV namespaces (deferred): HANDY_MAIL_KV, SESSION_KV, MYA_KV
        │
        └── Google Cloud Environment
            ├── Project: vists-498322
            ├── Vertex AI: gemini-2.5-pro (global)
            └── ADC auth (configured, daemon wiring pending)

THREE ENVIRONMENTS TO DATE:
  1. Local Environment       (Windows/Docker — primary runtime)
  2. Cloudflare Environment  (Edge — Workers, D1, KV, domain routing)
  3. Google Cloud Environment (Vertex AI — AI model access)

2. GIT BRANCH — NO CONFUSION
-----------------------------
"evidence-registry" is the active working branch where ALL system files live.
It was auto-created by the Vistamations-GitCommit task on 2026-08-09. The name
came from the title of an early commit ("Evidence Registry v2"). The "main"
branch contains only the initial commit and is effectively abandoned (19 commits
behind). You are on evidence-registry. That is the correct branch. Switch to
"main" and you lose everything.

---------------------------

- Publications (auto-discovered RUN reports)

- Cloudflare Workers: vistamations-agent-memory, mya, vistamations-home-bento
- Google Cloud: Gemini 2.5 Pro via Vertex AI

4. OLIVIA'S SPECIFIC MISSION (AG004)
-------------------------------------
"To enforce absolute order, guarantee message routing fidelity, monitor
system-wide bottlenecks, and coordinate team-wide remediation workflows."

Olivia is the operational nerve centre. All messages from Pete route through
the Olivia gate (POST /olivia/respond). All agent replies route back through
POST /olivia/agent-reply. The queue lives in crons/openclaw/olivia/queue.json.

Current operational state:
  - Message queue: Operational (manual trigger required for complex tasks)
  - Agent replies: Simple auto-reply patterns only (health, confirm, standby)
  - Dispatch daemon: MISSING (agent-daemon.js is a build spec, not daemon code)
  - Watchdog: Operational (checks process every 5 min, restarts if missing)
  - Dispatch: Operational (daily + 5-min repetition)
  - Status: Operational (daily 18:30)
  - No Google Docs connector: Planned but not wired

BLOCKER (G-1): The server writes messages to queue.json but no background
daemon processes them for complex agent delegation. Only simple pattern-matching
replies work. All complex tasks require manual /olivia-process invocation.
